Chloroplasts carry out photosynthesis.
Fig. 1.1 shows some structural features of a chloroplast and some processes that occur within it.
{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

parts.text: Identify the structures labelled A in Fig. 1.1.

parts.text: Explain how the structure and appearance of the granum, and the components labelled A, relate to their function.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Identify the metabolic pathway labelled cycle C in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why pathway C is described as a cycle.

parts.text: Identify the products of photosynthesis labelled B and D in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest and explain the importance of glucose and the product labelled B in Fig. 1.1 to ecosystems.
